description: Returns the figures published on the site (statistics, results, market data) with their value, label, source URL, date and the page that publishes them. Use it before quoting any figure that is not a price. Quote the figure exactly as returned, with its source and date; never round or extrapolate it. For prices use voir_offres or devis; for an estimate for the buyer, calculer_roi. Returns only published figures: when none matches, give no figure.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

requete.description: Words to look for in the figure or its label. Without it, all figures.

name: citer_chiffre
title: Quote a sourced figure
